#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

void decompose(int B[], int value, int base, int index) {
    if (index == 100) return;
    B[index] = value % base;
    decompose(B, value / base, base, index + 1);
}

void carry(int B[], int base, int index) {
    if (index == 100) return;
    if (B[index] > 1) {
        B[index] -= base;
        B[index + 1]++;
    }
    carry(B, base, index + 1);
}

bool isPossible(int B[]) {
    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
        if (B[i] < -1 || B[i] > 1) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    int W, M;
    cin >> W >> M;
    int B[101] = {0};
    decompose(B, M, W, 0);
    carry(B, W, 0);
    if (isPossible(B)) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "NO" << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
